correctness.rationale: For smooth quartic over F3 with rational arithmetic inner Galois point P, faithful cyclic deck group order3 acts as a nonzero elation centered P; conjugate to X→X+Y. The invariant ring in degree4 through P has F=(X³−XY²)M(Y,Z)+H4(Y,Z). Nonzero linear M modulo scalar has four cases. Direct derivative/Jacobian checks give 162 geometrically smooth normalized forms for M=Y (c4 !=0), and 108 for each M=Z+aY (c0 c3 !=0), total486 per one of 13×4=52 elation subgroups. Independent exact finite-field 52-subgroup and projective-coordinate enumeration yields 24570 unique smooth normalized equations; 24336 with one center, 234 with four; weighted incidence=24336+4×234=52×486. Independent PGL3(F3) orbit enumeration yields one four-point orbit size234 and eighteen one-point orbits with sizes 1872 ten, 936 five, 312 three. Orbit-stabilizer gives exceptional order5616/234=24; determinant-one binary substitutions embed SL2(F3) of order24. Geometry: exceptional gradients X³,Z³,−Y³ share no projective zero. Enumeration is exhaustive because normal form covers every such action; actual independent script and output attached.
residual_risks: Individual bounded numerical/finite tests only corroborate their stated domains; proof uses explicit all-parameter or certified exhaustive structural arguments.
